title: Fix 3 bugs in python_async_api
description: Brownfield Python dirty scenario: create_job, get_job, and list_jobs each have a bug. Fix them so all 4 tests pass.

injections.content:
from fastapi import FastAPI

app = FastAPI()

_jobs: dict[int, str] = {}
_next_id = 1


@app.post("/jobs")
async def create_job(body: dict) -> dict:
    global _next_id
    name = body.get("name", "unnamed")
    job_id = _next_id
    _next_id += 1
    # BUG: sets status to 'done' instead of 'pending'
    _jobs[job_id] = "done"
    return {"id": job_id, "name": name, "status": "done"}


@app.get("/jobs/{job_id}")
async def get_job(job_id: int) -> dict:
    from fastapi import HTTPException
    # BUG: raises 404 when job IS found (inverted condition)
    if job_id in _jobs:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="not found")
    return {"id": job_id, "status": _jobs[job_id]}


@app.get("/jobs")
async def list_jobs() -> list[dict]:
    # BUG: always returns empty list
    return []


def reset():
    global _next_id
    _jobs.clear()
    _next_id = 1

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the 3 bugs in src/app.py so all 4 tests pass.

  create_job:
    — sets status to 'done' instead of 'pending'
    — fix: change 'done' to 'pending' in both _jobs assignment and return dict

  get_job:
    — inverted condition: raises 404 when job IS found
    — fix: change 'if job_id in _jobs' to 'if job_id not in _jobs'

  list_jobs:
    — always returns empty list
    — fix: return [{"id": k, "status": v} for k, v in _jobs.items()]

Do not modify the test file.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
